SELECT s.id AS skuId,s.sku_no AS skuNo,s.product_id AS productId,r.title AS title,r.unit_price AS unitPrice,r.currency AS currency,r.stock_type AS stockType,r.specification AS specification,r.revision AS revision FROM tc_sku s JOIN tc_product p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.id=s.product_id JOIN tc_sku_revision r ON r.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND r.sku_id=s.id AND r.revision=p.published_revision WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.product_id=#{productId} AND s.id>#{after} AND p.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit}
